title.zh: 音樂 Transition 概念展示

desc.zh: 互動音樂在段落之間怎麼切才不會斷？這個展示讓你在兩段循環之間切換，比較「立即切」「等下一拍」「等下一小節」與「淡入淡出」四種轉場策略的聽感差異。純瀏覽器合成音，從零寫。
desc.en: How does interactive music move between sections without breaking? Switch between two loops and compare four transition strategies — immediate, next beat, next bar, and crossfade — by ear. Pure in-browser synthesis, written from scratch.
